blocks.text:
Devoko is a furniture brand committed to making home life better, hoping to give consumers more quality choices through high-quality goods.
This outdoor sectional couch is the great addition to your patio furniture collection. The versatile patio sectional couch is designed with easy assembly, can be set up in just a few short steps. With removable thickened cushions,you can sit on the couch and have a cozy sitting experience. Devoko outdoor sectional sofa will be your nice outdoor furniture choice.
Features:
Multiple Scenarios Using: A great set for patio, porch, balcony, poolside and other outdoor spaces
Natural Acacia wood: Adds elegance to your outdoor space.The wood is coated with water-based paint to prevent decay
 Reinforced structure: Crafted with sturdy frame, it can provide better support and improve the service life
 Removable thicken cushion: High-density sponge pillow can provide a good support for your back and waist
Easy assembly: Can be finished assembly in a few steps, no complicated tools are required
 Specifications:
Material: Acacia Wood
Overall Dimension：100 x 25 x25 in (L x W x H)
Net Weight：110.24lbs/100kg
Recommend : Do not use sharp objects or hard objects to scratch the surface, and storing it when it rains to prevent decay

items.label: - Versatile Configuration
items.value: The patio sectional furniture set allows for flexible arrangements, making it ideal for various settings such as backyards, gardens, and patio spaces, enhancing your outdoor experience with a stylish touch.

items.label: - Durable Acacia Wood
items.value: Crafted from high-quality acacia wood, this wood outdoor furniture is built to last, providing exceptional durability against the elements while maintaining its elegant appearance.

items.label: - Comfortable Seating Experience
items.value: Featuring soft and plush seat cushions, this patio sofa ensures ultimate comfort for you and your guests during gatherings, making it the perfect spot for conversations and relaxation.

items.label: - Easy Installation
items.value: With a user-friendly assembly guide included, setting up your outdoor couch is quick and hassle-free, allowing you to enjoy your patio space without delay.

items.label: - NOTE
items.value: While cushions are water-resistant, the wooden frame requires protection during heavy storms. It is recommended to store under the eaves in bad weather.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Easy to follow assembly instructions included
